# Solutions Marketing VIP

> SEO audits and monitoring for Montreal-area businesses. Transparent public pricing, no contracts, no setup or exit fees, privacy-first infrastructure (zero trackers). Bilingual English/French. https://solutionsmarketingvip.com

Solutions Marketing VIP provides website health audits, deep SEO audits, and monthly monitoring & repair for small businesses in the greater Montreal area. Original audit methodology produces a health score out of 100 with ranked, plain-language fixes. Content is available in English and French.

Key facts:
- Website Health Audit from $300 CAD — full diagnostic, yours to keep regardless of who you hire
- Deep Audit — every page analyzed, not sampled, quoted per site
- Monitoring & Repair — $650 CAD/month, monthly re-audit, cancel anytime
- No contracts, no setup fees, no exit fees
- Never promises #1 on Google — removes penalties and shows the evidence instead
- Website loads zero trackers, zero third-party fonts, zero analytics
- Clients keep all reports, documents, and accounts
